property_summary: After funding C and then calling withdrawAll(recipient), the recipient's balance increases exactly by the contract's previous balance (transfer either delivers full amount or reverts), i.e., withdrawAll never silently fails to transfer the funds.
If withdrawAll is called by the owner when the contract has a positive balance, the call must not revert (i.e., it must succeed).
When called by the owner, withdrawAll never reverts if the contract has a positive balance.
After withdrawAll is called by the owner, the specified _recipient's balance increases by the full contract balance sent (i.e., recipient receives all funds).
withdrawAll(msg.sender) always reverts when caller is not the contract owner, so a non-owner call must revert.

If withdrawAll(...) does not revert then the contract's entire balance is transferred to the provided _recipient (so address(c).balance becomes zero and address(this).balance increases accordingly for non-contract recipients).
Only calls from the contract owner can succeed; non-owner calls to withdrawAll must revert.
If the provided caller is not the contract owner then an attempted withdrawAll (made by any non-owner) must revert.
